mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (product_id, buyer_id, seller_id) VALUES (#{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId})
INSERT INTO messages (room_id, sender_id, text) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{text})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN chat_rooms cr ON m.room_id = cr.id WHERE (cr.buyer_id = #{userId} OR cr.seller_id = #{userId}) AND m.sender_id != #{userId} AND m.is_read = false
